assumptions.statement: The overall design boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints from the public repository, not trusted official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Current area and ratio metrics are low-confidence interim design-model values. Official geometry triggers full recalculation of all dependent geometry, metrics, figures, reports, drawings and HTML.
assumptions.current_action: Provenance, CRS, official_boundary=false, area-calculation CRS and the package-wide replacement rule are documented.
assumptions.trigger: The organizer publicly releases confirmed official geometry for the overall scope or any key area, with version and applicability information.
assumptions.owner: organizer for release; participant for replacement and recalculation
assumptions.next_output: Official geometry intake record plus fully recalculated bilingual package.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, building coverage, setbacks, control lines, ownership, building-by-building conditions, roof/underground conditions, heritage, transport, parking, rail, utilities, drainage, flood, fire, energy and cybersecurity constraints remain unavailable or incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Land use, massing, retain-renovate-demolish, mobility and infrastructure content remains conceptual and cannot be used as a statutory, approval or engineering conclusion.
assumptions.current_action: A discipline-by-discipline formal information request and a no-upgrade stop rule are recorded in report/narrative.md.
assumptions.trigger: The project enters site modification, engineering development or implementation study and formal professional information becomes available.
assumptions.owner: shared among organizer, rights holders, project owner and relevant professional disciplines
assumptions.next_output: Verified base drawings, control schedule, discipline review and revised design package.

assumptions.statement: Operating entities, site permissions, staff, insurance, costs, data agreements, dual-account governance and annual event resources have not been formally appointed or contracted.
assumptions.impact: Scenario schedules, industry tests, public-return mechanisms and phasing are operating recommendations whose launch depends on named owners, budgets and stop/restoration protocols.
assumptions.current_action: Nine launch gates and stop/restoration requirements are defined for TEST-01 through TEST-03; all three remain not_authorized.
assumptions.trigger: A scenario receives site-level in-principle agreement and is prepared for real public participation.
assumptions.owner: participant plus named site, safety, data, insurance and operating owners
assumptions.next_output: Signed scenario-level protocol and field/user accessibility test record.

assumptions.statement: The quantities, concept unit rates, CAPEX, OPEX, revenue, NOI and payback values in visual/assets/economics_model.json and the bilingual FIG-10 diagrams are participant-authored internal scenario inputs effective 2026-08-29.
assumptions.impact: They support comparison between light-start, standard and full-rollout concepts only. They are low-confidence until measured quantities, dated market quotations, tax and financing treatment, operator agreements and approved design information replace the current assumptions.
assumptions.current_action: All economic references are labeled internal conceptual scenario comparison, low evidence grade and not a budget, financing, procurement, marketing or investment basis.
assumptions.trigger: Before the proposal is used for budget, financing, procurement, marketing or investment-decision research.
assumptions.owner: shared among cost, finance, tax, financing, operating and project-owner professionals
assumptions.next_output: Measured quantities, comparable quotations, tax/financing basis, real contracts/orders and professionally reviewed revenue-cost forecast.

assumptions.statement: The interfaces with AI North Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing E-Town and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei network are proposed divisions based on public positioning, not signed cooperation.
assumptions.impact: No partner, contact, resource, procurement, city participation or annual target may be represented as confirmed until the relevant parties execute an agreement.
assumptions.current_action: A five-interface division-of-labor, transfer output, activation gate and six-step workflow are included in both languages.
assumptions.trigger: Both operating parties identify responsible contacts and agree on the task, rights boundary, resources, exit and result-return obligations.
assumptions.owner: relevant operating parties; Zhongguancun services wing as proposed transfer desk
assumptions.next_output: Signed interface sheet, project transfer record and annually auditable result return.
